bio: Nestling at the foot of a 14C tower in the heart of the famous wine-growing village, this traditional townhouse boasts an elegant, contemporary dining room offset by a scattering of period details (beams, ceiling and mouldings). Simplicity, authenticity and bags of character are the hallmarks of the food characterised by premium ingredients that keep pace with the seasons presented in an enticing lunchtime menu (that is also a steal!) and a surprise menu available in different versions in the evening. There is also an entirely vegetarian menu....
